children: , parent company of Peoples State Bank, is pleased to announce that on September 15, 2026, its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.18 per share of the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on October 30, 2026, to shareholders of record as of October 8, 2026. The current dividend continues a 61-year tradition of cash dividends to PSB shareholders.

PSB Holdings President and CEO Scott M. Cattanach said, “PSB leadership has been proud to consistently grow and pay shareholder dividends for many years as an important part of our shareholder value. Our merger partner, Bank First Corporation, has a similar focus on rewarding shareholders with dividends and is a good fit for our shareholders, as well as for our customers. Our shareholders’ next quarterly dividend for the December 2026 quarter is expected to occur after the closing of our merger and will be determined by Bank First Corporation as part of their normal governance process.”

PSB Holdings, Inc. is the parent company of Peoples State Bank. Peoples is a community bank headquartered in Wausau, Wisconsin, serving northcentral and southeastern Wisconsin from twelve full-service banking locations in Marathon, Oneida, Vilas, Portage, Milwaukee and Waukesha counties. Peoples also provides investment and insurance products, along with retirement planning services, through Peoples Wealth Management, a division of Peoples. PSB Holdings, Inc. is traded under the stock symbol PSBQ on the OTCQX Market. More information about PSB, its management, and its financial performance may be found at www.psbholdingsinc.com.
